title: Perfect Study Prompts
description: Prompt pack for students to learn faster, revise better, and score higher.
seoDescription: Use study prompts to create plans, summaries, and exam strategies.
intro: Copy-ready prompts designed for school, college, and self-learning.

prompts.title: 30-Day Exam Plan
prompts.description: Create a structured exam revision timeline.
prompts.text: Create a 30-day revision plan for [subject] with [hours] hours per day and weekly checkpoints.

prompts.title: Complex Topic Simplifier
prompts.description: Break difficult topics into simple steps.
prompts.text: Explain [topic] in simple language with examples and a 5-question self-test.

prompts.title: Active Recall Questions
prompts.description: Generate recall questions for memory retention.
prompts.text: Generate 25 active recall questions from this chapter: [paste chapter notes].

prompts.title: Smart Summary Builder
prompts.description: Turn long notes into concise revision points.
prompts.text: Summarize these notes into bullet points with formulas, definitions, and key dates: [notes].

prompts.title: Exam Strategy Coach
prompts.text: Give me an exam-day strategy for [exam type], including time allocation and question prioritization.

body:
